---
title: "Housing Price Index Overview"
---

Welcome to the Housing Price Index project. This homepage visualizes decades of quarterly home valuation changes across all U.S. states and metropolitan areas.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

df <- read_csv("data/hpi_master.csv")

ggplot(df, aes(x = yr, y = index_nsa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, color = "#2563eb") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. House Price Index Trends (1975–Present)",
    subtitle = "Data points representing over 100,000 observations",
    x = "Year",
    y = "House Price Index (Base 100)"
  )
